page.content:
Salia Arden-Govia was the niece of Bix Arden-Govia. A native of Bakura, she lived in its capital city Salis D'aar and grew up to be a starfighter pilot. She was a member of a patrol squadron in the Bakuran Defense Fleet.

page.overview:
Who is Salia Arden-Govia?

Salia Arden-Govia was the niece of Bix Arden-Govia. A native of Bakura, she lived in its capital city Salis D'aar and grew up to be a starfighter pilot. She was a member of a patrol squadron in the Bakuran Defense Fleet.
